report:
Reviewed the complete semantic_phase_boundary claim, its one ordinary implementation association in src/inspector.rs, and its sole associated TODO test in sage_meta::todo. Requirements are: semantic processing precedes serialization/browser rendering; tracked reads needed by reflection remain inside the recorded analysis/reflection interval; view assembly is explicit; downstream JSON/DOM work has no database access.

Implementation inspection: LiveInspectionProvider::product starts recording before directory lookup and identity_product, completes host.with_context before freezing the owned result, and records the product run with Analysis as its root phase. Local concrete-ir/signature/typed-ir/diagnostics and external signatures/items all call reflected_product or reflected_external_product. Both create a scoped reflection InspectionPhase before reflect_with_references and end it before assemble_reflected_page creates its explicit view-assembly phase. The resolver remains local to reflect_with_references; all its reads of names, source paths, token trees, derive expansions, generic parameters and symbol references execute synchronously during value.reflect. Reflection finish and continuation extraction return owned ValueNode trees. Cached reference presentations are already owned; fallback owner/external-reference resolution is invoked under the same reflection scope. Identity/source products construct owned render trees within the outer recorded analysis operation. Continuation delivery clones retained owned nodes rather than reflecting anew. assemble_reflected_page only constructs the owned page and logs its phase; it does not perform tracked reads.

Captured supporting type/API fragments show ValueNode, SymbolReference, ProductPage and RenderNode hold owned data with derived serialization, with no database handles or lazy callbacks. The HTTP product handler awaits a completed product response, and ApiResponse::into_response/pretty_json serialize that response without a database argument. This substantiates the backend serialization boundary; browser interaction behavior remains deferred evidence rather than an asserted browser test result.

The complete associated test function contains no assertions and is explicitly TODO. Its rationale identifies the missing complete evidence: real-product phase tests, component interaction tests over owned trees, and a source-driven browser demand trace exercising filtering, resizing, growth, collapse and expansion without semantic requests. Accept this existing test deferral as visible incomplete verification, not as test adequacy or executed behavior. The prerequisite to converting it to ordinary evidence is associating/reviewing those substantive scenarios with visible assertions (including no tracked work after reflection and no semantic browser demand for local UI operations). A regression moving resolver work beyond the recorded boundary or introducing a UI-triggered semantic request would not be caught by this placeholder. No ordinary associated test, N/A entry, or additional TODO implementation exists.

Commands performed: review start, review read for review policy and supporting reflection/protocol/server fragments, and source inspection. One out-of-bounds server read was corrected to the valid final line. No behavioral tests or browser execution were run, and no source edits were made. The recorded outcome accepts the inspected implementation and explicit existing test deferral; it does not claim end-to-end verification.
